question: **Direction: Choose the incorrectly spelt word.**
solution:
Here, the correct answer is "Contaxte."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****
 
__
 
• The incorrectly spelt word is **"Contaxte."**
 
• The correct spelling is **"Context."**
 
• **"Context" **means the situation in which something happens or that caused something to happen. (संदर्भ, प्रसंग)
 
 
• **Example**: *To put our company in **context**__, we are now the third largest in the country.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__ 

 
• Station: **a building on a railway line where trains stop so that passengers can get on and off. (रेलवे स्‍टेशन; स्‍टेशन)
 
• **Magic: **the secret power that some people believe can make strange or impossible things happen if you say special words or do special things. ((विशेष शब्‍दों या क्रियाओं के प्रयोग द्वारा) असाधारण या असंभव बातें कर दिखाने वाली एक गुप्‍त शक्ति; जादू, इंद्रजाल)
 
• **Charity: **an organization that collects money to help people who are poor, sick, etc. or to do work that is useful to society; the money or gifts collected or given to people who are poor, sick, etc. (धन इकट्ठा कर दीनों-दुखियों की सहायता करने वाली संस्‍था; सहायतार्थ संस्‍था; दान की गई राशि, वस्‍तुएँ आदि)
